replicad-opencascadejs 1.1.0 — LGPL-2.1-only (opencascade-LICENSE.txt)
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/replicad-opencascadejs/v/1.1.0
Corresponding source/build configuration: https://github.com/sgenoud/replicad/tree/e4b05f67dc4e2393a876ce8c5064a9c93db05bf1/packages/replicad-opencascadejs
OpenCascade.js build source: https://github.com/taucad/opencascade.js/tree/ebd263f1
This application uses facilities provided by Open CASCADE Technology.
The upstream OCCT exception notice is included in OCCT-Exception.txt.
The WebAssembly kernel is distributed as a separate, replaceable asset in assets/.
Rebuild with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build; kernel source and build
configuration are available at the source link above. No kernel modifications are made.
